Read every "day" in this chart as one hour: "Day 12" means hour 12, and "12 days" means 12 hours.
1 day cell = 1 hour of Claude agent wall-clock time on this host. Hour 0 = start of the ASI work (now).
Bars are rounded to whole hours. Short tasks that share an hour cell on one lane are done together in that hour.
Heavy-run lane: one build, test suite or network session at a time. Campaign slots on the lane are inferences.
Bars marked not to scale stand for dates nobody knows. Each later block is measured from its milestone.
